notes: The unavailable historical digitization used by Na.cpp is not claimed as provenance.
This package qualifies the published curve only to its frozen graphical uncertainty.

selection_rule.exclusion_reason: The March/April arrows or circular markers obscure the plotted curve. These exclusions are based only on figure legibility, not agreement with AMPS. Axis endpoints are omitted because the plotted curve merges with the top/side frame.
selection_rule.included: Every 5 km/s location from -45 through +45 whose curve trace is not crossed or covered by an annotation arrow or marker in both rasterizations; zero velocity is retained because the minimum is unobscured.

source.authors: M. R. Combi, M. A. DiSanti, and U. Fink
source.reproduction: NASA NTRS report 19990024948, printed page 13, PDF page 25
source.title: The Spatial Distribution of Gaseous Atomic Sodium in the Comae of Comets: Evidence for Direct Nucleus and Extended Plasma Sources

transformations: PDF page rasterized independently at 150 and 300 dpi
midpoint of visible curve line thickness
arithmetic mean of the two raster-derived accelerations
